v2.1.0 Add search API and performance improvements
Jane Doe released this about 2 days ago
a1b2c3d - v2.1.0

  ## What's Changed                                                           
                                                                              
  ### New Features                                                            
  - Full-text search API endpoint using PostgreSQL tsvector                   
  - Search results pagination with cursor-based navigation                    
  - Search suggestions based on recent queries                                
                                                                              
  ### Performance                                                             
  - Optimized database queries for listing endpoints (40% faster)             
  - Added Redis caching layer for frequently accessed resources               
  - Reduced memory footprint of background workers                            
                                                                              
  ### Bug Fixes                                                               
  - Fixed session timeout not respecting configuration values                 
  - Fixed locale detection for Swiss German users                             
  - Fixed race condition in concurrent payment processing                     
                                                                              
  ### Dependencies                                                            
  - Updated Spring Boot to 3.2.4                                              
  - Updated PostgreSQL driver to 42.7.2                                       
  - Updated Redis client to 4.6.1
